crime: At every meal in the dining hall, one girl picks a flower from the vase for each plate, the way her grandmother once did at the family table. She always keeps {WITCH_NAME} at her side. Whenever the table gets loud, {WITCH_NAME} touches the vase and steps inside it, hidden among the stems.

One evening the girl takes the clover from {WITCH_NAME}'s collar, a clover {WITCH_NAME} picked herself that morning, and lays a lily by her plate. "This one is yours." Then she tucks the clover in among the old stems in the vase.
Years ago, {WITCH_NAME} picked a dandelion for her own hair. Her mother unpinned it and pinned a silk rose there instead.
{WITCH_NAME} slips her hand in among the stems, closes her fingers on her clover, and is gone.

At dusk, as always, the girl lifts the old stems from the vase into her basket to float them on the lake. "Leave her in there," she tells the others. "She's hiding." As she kneels at the water's edge to set the flowers adrift, {WITCH_NAME} steps out of the clover and holds her face under the shallows until she is still.

All evening, until lockup call, the prisoners play cards around the vase. When the girl isn't back by lockup call, they go looking and find her face down in the shallows among the old flowers, finger marks on the back of her neck. When they come back and call for {WITCH_NAME}, she steps out of the vase.
In the trial court, the prisoners rule her out. "She was in the vase at our table all evening."

Then one prisoner notices a dried green strand of lake weed caught on her cuff button. The prisoners realize she rode out to the lake in her clover and slipped back into the vase while they were out searching.
fields.epitaph: The one thing she ever chose for herself was a place to hide.
fields.epithet: The Girl Whose Every Flower Was Chosen for Her
execution: A giant white lily rises on a tall stem, and she is set upright in its open bloom, high under the ceiling. The lily begins to wilt, its bloom bowing slowly toward the floor. The wilted petals are too soft to hold her, and she slides out headfirst onto the floor. The lily hangs wilted over her, and her still body lies under a fallen petal.

magic.name: Hide-and-Seek
magic.text: She can step inside any object she touches and stay there, seeing and hearing everything outside.
